Product & artwork

Calibrated model of the kit in your reference photo. Artwork is sampled from that photograph; hidden surfaces and depth remain approximations. Choose another representation to use a different product photograph.

Crop / mask photograph

Optional mask also removes white product details. Review the preview; no automatic background removal is assumed.

Photos stay attached to this SKU. Aspect ratio and alpha are preserved. Unknown faces remain neutral; a photo is not a complete 3D model.

Print artwork on display

Blank surfaces remain neutral. Branding is shared between templates. Side artwork applies to closed side walls; open four-face pallets and bare metal fixtures use header / fascia artwork.
